answer.explanation: In the window, ThumbnailerFunction fails on every invocation with NoSuchBucket on PutObject. The live OUTPUT_BUCKET is 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', last modified at 00:26:58Z, just before the window. The IaC template intends `!Ref OutputBucket`, which is the working bucket used by the other functions. Commit 32da483 introduced the literal bad value and commit e83110e reverted it, yet the deployed config still carries the bad value. The drift therefore came from outside the committed template, so the live configuration is the root cause, not the IaC or the code. The IAM policy and code paths are not implicated: the error is a missing bucket, not AccessDenied.
